title: Multiplicity and solution construction in linear elliptic problems with nonlocal nonlinearities
summary: This work investigates linear elliptic equations with multiple nonlocal nonlinearities in a bounded domain, which takes the form \begin{equation*} -\nabla\cdot(\od\nabla u) +λfu= η\sum_{j=1}^kh_j\boldsymbol{\mathsf{N}}_j[u]+h_0. \end{equation*} Here $λ$ and $η$ are positive parameters, and $\boldsymbol{\mathsf{N}}_j[u]$ represents a nonlocal term dependent on the unknown solution~$u$. All coefficients are defined in the context of a wide range of applications.
